mapper.select: SELECT o.*, h.id as h_id, h.name as h_name, h.address as h_address, h.image_url as h_image_url, h.owner_id as h_owner_id FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN homestay h ON o.homestay_id = h.id WHERE h.owner_id = #{landlordId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.*, h.id as h_id, h.name as h_name, h.address as h_address, h.image_url as h_image_url, h.owner_id as h_owner_id FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN homestay h ON o.homestay_id = h.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.*, h.id as h_id, h.name as h_name, h.address as h_address, h.image_url as h_image_url, h.owner_id as h_owner_id, e.id as e_id, e.name as e_name, e.location as e_location, e.image_url as e_image_url, u.id as u_id, u.username as u_username, u.phone as u_phone, u.email as u_email, u.name as u_name FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN homestay h ON o.homestay_id = h.id LEFT JOIN experience e ON o.experience_id = e.id LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
